messages:
zoe_marketing: Hey runtime — planning final launch post and webinar. Need a small, reproducible bench pack we can cite publicly.

zoe_marketing: Core asks: 600 anonymized samples stratified by token length (short/med/long), run fp16 + int8, include embed + rerank flow (embed all candidates then gen top-k), measure p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, and per-1M-token cost for gen and per-1M-embed cost.

rafael_runtime: We can do that. Quick clarifiers: (1) rerank candidates count? (2) do you want cached candidate embeddings for a warmed scenario as well?

zoe_marketing: Use 10 candidates for rerank. Include both uncached (single-pass) and cached variants so we can show both worst-case and optimized flows. Also want a short heatmap of seq_len vs latency for p99.

katie_eng-runtime: Running on staging (A10g). We'll include a short correction note for prod A100p. Plan: 3 repeats per variant, coldstart = pod restart, warm = 4 warmup requests per worker. We'll upload CSV + demo trace + runner script.

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: bench-pack-1798881234 queued on staging at 2025-06-11T08:30:00Z. Job id: bench-pack-1798881234.

rafael_runtime: Interim coldstart p95 (med) fp16=540ms, int8=460ms. No OOMs. Recording full traces.

nina_growth: For webinar slide we want one crisp stat: exact % improvement p95 int8 vs fp16 on 256-token med slice. Can you include that micro-run?

rafael_runtime: Micro-run med 256 tokens (median of 3): fp16 p95=535ms, int8 p95=445ms -> ~16.8% reduction. tokens/sec fp16=215, int8=255. est cost/1M tokens fp16=$12.40, int8=$10.60.

katie_eng-runtime: Bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-staging/bench-pack-1798881234/bundle.zip. Contains CSV (fields: variant, slice, run_type, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tps, est_cost_per_1M_tokens), runner script, warmup seed list, and heatmap image. Added one-line reproducibility blurb for the blog.

zoe_marketing: Perfect. Paste the one-line blurb and runner config snippet here and we'll pull into the post.

rafael_runtime: Blurb: "Benchmarks measured on staging (A10g) with anonymized stratified inputs; reported values are medians of 3 runs. See attached traces for full reproducibility."

rafael_runtime: Runner-config snippet: "workers=6; batching.max_tokens=2048; batching.max_batch_size=28; warmup.per_worker=4; seed_file=bench-pack-1798881234-seeds.txt; repeats=3"

zoe_marketing: Thanks — we'll draft language and tag you for sign-off tomorrow.
